blurb: Guests board a pirate-themed cruise departing from Clearwater Beach. The cruise offers a family-friendly experience with scheduled departures daily. Parking is available at the Municipal Marina Parking lot with pay per plate system.
extraNote: Parking is pay per plate at $1 per hour at kiosks in the Municipal Marina Parking lot. · Parking code provided in confirmation email for one-time use per day. · Same day reservations cannot be made online; call to book. · Municipal Marina Parking lot, 25 Causeway Blvd., Clearwater Beach, FL 33767

quotes.text: My kids loved it and had a smile on their face the whole time. The crew really made the cruise so much fun for the kids they didn’t even know it was 2hrs. The kids were smiles. The parents got the relax and enjoy the sunset while they had fun and didn’t have to be the helicopter parent for 2hrs. How fun for the kids and relaxing for the parents. Great job making this so kid friendly! We will be back and also be recommending this cruise to other people.
We thoroughly enjoyed our time with you all. The guests had a blast. We will surely come back in the future.
Our group had an amazing time!! They still talk about it! Great job to the crew!
